Miss Emily repeatedly defies the expectation that she will be merely a controlling, class-conscious mother-in-law: she advises Nora toward financial independence even against Daniel’s wishes, publicly champions her competence, and keeps a workplace mistake separate from family affection. These turns fit her established practicality and hard-earned experience. The final adjustment of Nora’s coat cuffs likewise transforms an apparent correction into an ambiguous gesture of care, bringing their developing relationship to a surprising but fitting close.
